sn21.5:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || || Atha kho āyasmā Sujāto yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || || Addasā kho Bhagavā ayasmantaṃ Sujātaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ || || Disvāna bhikkhū āmantesi || || Ubhayenevāyam bhikkhave kulaputto sobhati vata || || Yañ ca abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato || || Yassa catthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajanti || tad anuttaram brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti || || Idam avoca Bhagavā || pe|| satthā || ||
sn21.5:2.1: Sobhati vatāyaṃ bhikkhu || ujubhūtena cetasā || vippayutto visaññutto || anupādāya nibbūto || dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ || jetvā Māraṃ savāhananti || || Pañcamaṃ || ||
